title: Users and personas (section 4)
description: Who uses it, what they want, and what hurts today.

id.description: Stable identifier; never reused or renumbered.

name.description: The role, not a person's name: 'Discharge coordinator at a district hospital'.

short_name.description: The role in one or two words with no spaces, such as DomainExpert. Diagrams use it in place of the persona id.

frequency.description: How often they use the product: daily, per engagement, once.

authority.description: What they may approve. Feeds section 10.

primary.description: The persona the product serves first. At most one.

external.description: Outside the organization that owns the product.

population.description: How many people hold this role, per organization.

context.description: The conditions of use, such as interruptions or noise. No device or platform.

basis.description: Research, with its source, or assumed.

problems.description: The problems in section 1 this persona has.
